name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Cedric goes with Pottery or Candles goes with Edmund.
Needle does not go with Pottery.
Loom goes with at least two of Wulfric, Rope, and Kingsford.
Exactly one of these is true: Wulfric goes with Candles; Needle goes with Highrow; Candles goes with Highrow.
Rowan goes with exactly two of Loom, Rope, and Highrow.
Rowan, Chisel, Candles, and Southgate belong to different artisans.
If Kingsford goes with Loom, then Loom goes with Wulfric.
